                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 5/26/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Dowell (3)
Type:                         Ordinance
Titie:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-E at 180,1-1901 8
                              Indiana Ave, 205-217 E 18th St and 1806-1836 S Prairie
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                    ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all the Institutional Planned Development* 286
symbols and indications as shown on Map No 4-E in the area bounded by

       East 18th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Indiana Avenue; a
       line 74 feet south of and parallel to East 18th Street; South Prairie Avenue; a line
       394.83 feet south of and parallel to East 18th Street; the alley next east of and
       parallel to South Prairie Avenue; a line 467.33 feet south of and parallel to East
       18th Street; and South Indiana Avenue,

to those of a POS-2, Parks and Open Space District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.




                                             Pat Dowell
                                             Alderman, 3'" Ward




Common Address of Property:
1801-1901 S Indiana Ave
205-17 E    St
1806-36 S Prairie Ave
